intent: A quiet line or dot grid behind a demo or hero, fading out toward the edges. Decorative only; the foreground keeps its full contrast.
useWhen: behind a product demo, hero or empty state on a docs or marketing page
to frame one featured component in a showcase
doNotUseWhen: behind dense data UI, forms or long text
as a layout grid — use layout classes and --grid-* tokens
as a chart's gridlines — LineChart and BarChart draw their own

variant.note: lines every space.6 (24px) in border.faint; dots every space.4 (16px) in border.strong.

inverse.note: surface.inverse with the grid at opacity.100 of line.inverse, edge to edge, no fade.

motion.note: Static. Paper's optional slow drift (≥ 40s per cell) is not built: it needs a duration far outside the motion tokens. Proposed in NOTES.md.

requirements: the grid layer is aria-hidden and has no pointer events
children are untouched and keep their contrast
the grid is hidden under forced colours

doNot: Do not put text directly on the grid without a surface behind it
Do not hard-code cell sizes or columns
